name: Vampire - Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only) - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a attack

results.text: Your fangs sink deep into tender flesh, a gush of blood singing to your hunger.
Life force pours forth like liquid shadow, your body swelling with stolen vigor.
The victim’s scream echoes through the night as their vitality becomes yours.
A crimson tide floods your senses, the necrotic magic binding them to you eternally.
Your jaw clamps down with unnatural force, and their soul trembles in your grasp.
